title: RTC freshness does not include accumulated age after sample observation
description: Timing correctness review: RTC adoption checks only snapshot `rtc_age_seconds`, while expiry independently checks only elapsed sample age. With rtc age 299 and max age 300, the source remains valid two seconds later even though effective age is 301. Evaluate rtc age plus monotonic elapsed at adoption, every authoritative read, and policy replacement. Add exact boundary, one-over, expiry, and monotonic regression tests.
